history.dynasty: Naga (Phaninagvansh / Faninagvansh) dynasty; Kalachuri period complex
history.period: 1089 AD (main stone temple, per Wikipedia); complex spans 7th-12th centuries
history.summary: Historic Shiva temple complex at Chaura village, ~18 km north-west of Kawardha, called the 'Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh' for its erotic sculptures in the Khajuraho-Konark idiom. The main stone temple (1089 AD, credited to Lakshman Dev Rai & Gopal Dev of the Faninagvansh/Naga dynasty) faces east with an east-facing garbhagriha housing a Shiva Linga, Gurur-style shikhara, and sculpted tiers of gods, erotic and mythical figures in black and ochre stone; the ten avatars of Vishnu flank the sanctum door. The complex also holds the ruined Istaliq brick temple (one of the earliest, 2nd-3rd c. per ASI notes cited on Wikipedia), an open-air museum with 2nd-3rd c. antiquities and Sati pillars, Cherki Mahal, and Madwa Mahal ~1 km away. The Gond tribals worshipped Shiva as 'Bhoramdeo', giving the temple its name; the Chhattisgarh government announced a Rs 146 crore Bhoramdev Corridor (Swadesh Darshan 2.0) in January 2026. CONFLICT FLAG: construction is variously dated between the 7th and 12th centuries and credited to different Naga kings (Lakshman Dev Rai/Gopal Dev; Naga kings of Chakrakota per a Hindu article) — the 1089 AD attribution is the most specific but not unanimous. name: Bhoramdeo Temple
town_description: Kawardha (officially Kabirdham) is the headquarters town of Kabirdham district in central Chhattisgarh, set at the foot of the Maikal hills; it is the gateway to the Bhoramdeo temple complex and the surrounding forested heritage belt.
tradition: Shaivism (with Vaishnavite and Jain sculptural elements)

travel.railway: Raipur is the nearest railhead (Bombay-Howrah main line)
travel.road: 18 km north-west of Kawardha; Kawardha is 116 km from Raipur, 133 km from Rajnandgaon, 220 km from Jabalpur by road

visitor_information.best_time: October-March (cooler months); monsoon is lush but roads may be difficult
